title: Special Topics in Leadership; Asian American Leadership
department: Higher Ed, Student Affairs, and International Ed Policy
description: Students will be introduced to leadership models and examples specific to Asian American & Pacific Islander communities throughout history and in current times. While the central objective of this course is to develop politically engaged and historically informed leaders and community members for the AAPI campus community, this course is open to anyone who is interested in social justice and learning more about student organizing around identity.
